compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is from an application called "Power Clean." The main content of the screen is a prompt indicating that the device's storage is full. It suggests cleaning the cache and trash to free up space. The screen features a prominent red circle with the text "Storage is full?" in the center. Below this, there is a red button labeled "Clean Cache And Trash," which likely initiates the cleaning process. There is also a red "X" icon at the bottom, which may be used to close the prompt or cancel the action.
